entries.requirement: Unknown dataset, universe, symbol or price view fails closed.
entries.title: Registered inputs only

entries.requirement: Candidate data requires an authorized consumption policy and matching registered validation manifest.
entries.title: Candidate validation binding

entries.requirement: A non-empty run directory is rejected; prior evidence is not deleted or overwritten.
entries.title: Immutable run output

entries.requirement: Missing intervals remain explicit gaps; OHLCV bars are never synthesized silently.
entries.title: No bar imputation

entries.requirement: The bounded execution/replay view is quote_guarded_1m; daily-adjusted and split-normalized prices are not fill prices.
entries.title: Raw execution view

entries.requirement: A one-minute bar becomes observable no earlier than its declared available_at, currently ts_start plus one minute.
entries.title: Availability causality

entries.requirement: Events are stably ordered; gap events precede bars when available_at ties.
entries.title: Deterministic event order

entries.requirement: Replay emits ReplayGapEvent rather than imputing a missing bar.
entries.title: Explicit gap events

entries.requirement: Disabling hash verification is prohibited and mismatches fail closed.
entries.title: Mandatory replay hashes

entries.requirement: A scheduled decision must precede the proxy execution timestamp.
entries.title: Decision precedes execution

entries.requirement: Mechanical short fills and PnL do not establish borrow, locate, fees or real tradability.
entries.title: No tradability inference

entries.requirement: Cash, position, gross PnL, costs, net PnL and equity derive from fills and reconcile.
entries.title: Fill-derived ledger

entries.requirement: Commission, minimums and additional components remain individually traceable before total costs.
entries.title: Separated cost components

entries.requirement: Rates such as 0.005 are not rounded to cents before multiplication or serialization.
entries.title: Sub-cent rate preservation

entries.requirement: V0.1 uses bar_based_execution_profile; quote-aware execution remains reserved and unauthorized.
entries.title: Bar-based primary profile

entries.requirement: A decision cannot obtain a fill from the bar already used to create that decision.
entries.title: Same-bar lookahead prohibition

entries.requirement: Limit fills never cross the economic limit; V0.1 price improvement is disabled.
entries.title: Limit price protection

entries.requirement: A stop gapped through uses the adverse source-bar open before deterministic adverse slippage.
entries.title: Adverse stop gap rule

entries.requirement: Initial supported fills are full fills only; partial fills and liquidity sizing fail closed as unsupported.
entries.title: Full-fill-only subset

entries.requirement: base → gap → slippage → tick → notional → costs → ledger rounding → reconciliation, using ROUND_HALF_EVEN at the declared monetary boundary.
entries.title: Canonical decimal sequence

entries.requirement: FUTURE_PROVIDER_REGISTRY_INTEGRATION, StateReplayFeed, physical StateBundle reads, Market/Event State consumption and state-driven backtest execution remain unauthorized until explicit compatibility and bounded physical-consumption gates close.
entries.title: Consumer hold

entries.requirement: Every closed gate binds decisions, policies, implementation, tests, evidence and limitations.
entries.title: Gate traceability

entries.requirement: Contradictory live statuses block dependent implementation authorization until corrected or explicitly waived.
entries.title: Status consistency

entries.requirement: MARKET_PROXY, LIMIT and STOP_MARKET_PROXY may evaluate only source bars where order_submission_timestamp <= source_bar.ts_start.
entries.title: Exact source-bar eligibility

entries.requirement: tick_size_policy_id = PASSTHROUGH_SOURCE_PRICE_WITH_DECLARED_DECIMAL_PRECISION; any other required tick policy fails closed.
entries.title: V0.1 tick policy

entries.requirement: Fixed slippage is a per-share unit price adjustment; BPS slippage = base_price * slippage_bps / 10000; computed fill_price <= 0 returns REJECTED_BY_CONTRACT.
entries.title: Exact slippage formulas and positive price guard

entries.requirement: Cost components declare side applicability, mathematical basis, zero defaults, sub-cent preservation and ledger rounding order; nonzero borrow fee requires later borrow authorization.
entries.title: Deterministic V0.1 cost formulas

entries.requirement: Each order evaluation resolves to a single canonical outcome using the precedence defined in the execution contract.
entries.title: Canonical outcome precedence

entries.requirement: Each evaluated opportunity emits one EVALUATION_OUTCOME; EXPIRED_UNFILLED is only a terminal outcome after no fill/reject occurs before DAY expiry.
entries.title: Evaluation vs terminal outcomes

entries.requirement: ambiguous_bar_policy = FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_BAR_ONLY in V0.1; PESSIMISTIC is reserved/not implemented.
entries.title: Fail ambiguous bar only

entries.requirement: gross_notional = abs(fill_quantity) * fill_price.
entries.title: Gross notional formula

entries.requirement: Under ambiguous_bar_policy = FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_BAR_ONLY, ambiguous intrabar sequence produces EVALUATION_OUTCOME = FAIL_AMBIGUOUS_BAR and TERMINAL_ORDER_OUTCOME = REJECTED_BY_CONTRACT; PESSIMISTIC is reserved/not implemented.
entries.title: Ambiguous bar canonical failure mapping

entries.requirement: BT-GATE-006 closure permits opening DETERMINISTIC_FILL_SIMULATOR_V0_1_AUTHORIZATION as a decision gate only; code implementation remains NOT_AUTHORIZED until that gate explicitly authorizes bounded implementation.
entries.title: Contract closure does not authorize implementation

entries.requirement: Code implementation is authorized only for DETERMINISTIC_FILL_SIMULATOR_V0_1 as bounded by document 08 and contract 07; BT-GATE-010 must validate implementation and acceptance before any capability is declared implemented.
entries.title: Bounded simulator implementation only

entries.requirement: The deterministic fill simulator V0.1 has been accepted by BT-GATE-010; future use remains limited by its V0.1 non-claims.
entries.title: Acceptance pending after implementation

entries.requirement: BT-GATE-011 integrated StrategySpec, controlled QG5 universe, PIT scheduled decisions pre-registered before replay, HistoricalReplayFeed, ONLINE_REPLAY_COORDINATOR_V0_1, active orders, Deterministic Fill Simulator, online accounting, Trade Ledger, metrics, Unified Run Manifest, historical run, tests, determinism evidence, portable rerun evidence and final acceptance packet as one accepted capability gate.
entries.title: Single integrated gate for first end-to-end backtest

entries.requirement: BT-GATE-012 is authorized to implement and must prove multi-symbol, multi-session, shared-cash portfolio execution with GLOBAL_REPLAY_ORDER_V0_1, ACTIVE_ORDER_EVALUATION_ORDER_V0_1, explicit no-capital-contention boundary, PORTFOLIO_EQUITY_POLICY_V0_1 using PORTFOLIO_VALUATION_PRICE_FIELD=close, REGULAR_ONLY_XNYS_V0_1 session failure policy with TSIS_PORTABLE_SESSION_CALENDAR_SNAPSHOT_V0_1 authority and SHA-256, fixture acceptance profile, online accounting, session boundaries, portfolio ledger/equity curve and portable rerun evidence while preserving all no-edge and no-state-consumption restrictions.
entries.title: BT-GATE-012 portfolio slice contract boundary
BT-GATE-013 physical replay boundary policy
entries.requirement: BT-GATE-013 must prove the physical 013_ohlcv_1m_quote_guarded row to accepted replay engine boundary, including row lineage, source hashes, timestamp semantics, legal available_at, gaps, calendar/session enforcement and deterministic replay. It must not introduce Market State, Event State, StateReplayFeed, borrow/locates, SSR, halts, liquidity/capacity, batch research, DSR/PBO/CSCV, optimization or edge claims.
